name: mirage
text: That's an important clue. CNO's list is read from CNO's own website, not from the GitHub list or Vigilant's own scan. If CNO's bets miss in the same way, the list isn't the common factor. What they share is Novig itself: the price you buy at and the order that goes out. That points away from the list changes and toward either Novig's book changing (asks that show but won't fill) or something in the order step shared by every bet. I'm checking the order step as well as the prices when the 4:55 PM report arrives. If you can, tell me roughly how many CNO bets missed against filled.
